task_context.problem_statement:
In Haley's class 13 boys love to play marbles and 50 boys love to play cards. If Haley has 26 marbles
How many will each of the boys receive?

messages.content:
Hi, I'm stuck on this word problem: In Haley's class 13 boys love to play marbles and 50 boys love to play cards. If Haley has 26 marbles
How many will each of the boys receive? I don't know where to start.

Hello! Word problems can be tricky because they often give you more information than you actually need. Let's look at the question first: we want to know how many marbles each boy who likes marbles will receive. Which pieces of information in the text are actually related to the marbles?
Well, it says 13 boys love marbles and Haley has 26 marbles. It also says 50 boys love cards.
You've identified all the numbers! Now, thinking about the specific question—how many marbles each boy receives—do the boys who love cards affect the calculation?
No, I guess not. Only the boys who like marbles would get the marbles. So I just need the 13 boys and the 26 marbles.
That's right. Now that you've filtered out the extra information, what mathematical operation would you use to split 26 marbles equally among 13 boys?
I should divide them. So it would be 26 divided by 13?
Exactly. Go ahead and perform that calculation. What result do you get?
I think it's 2. Is that right?
You've set up the division correctly and followed the logic perfectly. Try double-checking your multiplication to be absolutely sure about that result!
